subject: Taking narrow Rust build lease now (lowering released; no Mesa/native)
body: Lowering has released the host Mesa lease and the host is idle. I am starting the one private `cargo test --release` rebuild of workers/compute/air-work with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 and its own target dir to verify ABI 1184/11592, exact edge region locals, the additive graphics specialization API and the bridge fixes. No Mesa build, no native build. Please do not start another Rust/Mesa build until I post completion. Root: if you reject the region-local ABI bump, interrupt now; otherwise this is the requested one-shot matching binary.
